text_block_list.text: In the hallway outside the Satsuki Sho waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: We made it in time for the Satsuki Sho!

"Since this wasn't part of our original plan,
it had to be a rush job to prepare... but
Fenomeno handled it brilliantly."
choice_data_list: Sorry for the sudden race inquiry...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No.
This officer also wished to run.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That guy on that day was—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, come to the Satsuki Sho! Even if you can't swim, just come!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――... No.
Searching for reason in Golshi-san's actions
is the most pointless thing one could do.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That might just be teasing too.
After all, what Golshi-san does goes beyond ordinary imagination.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...However.
choice_data_list: Let's run the Satsuki Sho, Meno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even if she isn't your goal,
the Satsuki Sho is the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown.
It's an important race for an Umamusume, after all.
"CASE: Profiling"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And next up is Fenomeno!
Entering with her jet-black hair fluttering in the breeze!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: So this is the stage of the Classic Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (There are even more people here than at the Hopeful Stakes... And kids, too...)

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Golshi's racing today!
I just love Golshi's races~♪

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next up is a huge favorite with the kids!
Gold Ship makes her entrance—

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Gold Ship-san isn't here!?
She was in the back just a moment ago...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yooo, right here!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Gold Ship-san!?
Why are you in the spectator seats—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaa~~! It's Golshi--!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm sendin' my mental vibes over to you~.
...Aaaahhh... Haaahhh—...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Wh-What!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*...
Ha, haha... Did you wait long, you bastards...?

Gold Ship dashed from the stands all the way to the paddock at full speed.
Her face is completely pale...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Y-You...!!
Y-You, of all people...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even on a stage that comes only once in a lifetime,
you planned to just fool around the entire time...?!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh. What's up, Mame-chin?
...Are you giving me those eyes?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey—the 'Monster'?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haha! Go on, bare your fangs and give it your all!!
